$comment: Home SDUI page contract (CT-07a; operation slots CT-27). Shape: 规划/03 §6.1; client handling: 03 §6.2; card registry: 03 §6.3; jump targets and per-platform min_app_version: 04 §10.1; NoticeItem: 04 §6.2; ad_label: BR-TEXT-17; operation slots (运营位): 04 §6.2「运营位」, BR-TEXT-28～30. The root is one delivered page (GET /v1/pages/{page_key}, preview, and the sections the console saves and reads back use $defs/section). page_key is home, me, search or custom:<slug>. Each of home, me and search has an admission definition ($defs/admission_home, admission_me, admission_search: the JSON Schema of that page's sections array, BR-TEXT-28 准入表), which the server's save / publish check and the console form read; the root applies admission_me and admission_search by page_key, custom:* keeps the checks it had. On home the 8 registered section types are validated strictly by type and any other type is an unknown card: only the section envelope is checked and the client skips it silently (03 §6.2; saving an unregistered type is refused by the server); me and search admit only their listed types. Every section and every static data source item may carry start_at / end_at (ISO 8601 with +08:00, BR-TEXT-11 / BR-TEXT-29; absent = not limited); the server sends only what is inside its range and the client filters again by its own clock. Jump targets are {route, params} (RouteTarget of openapi.yaml): route names are not enumerated here, a server may send a route newer than the client (03 §4.4); on me and search every jump target is an in-app target ($defs/in_app_target, BR-TEXT-30), the original home types keep RouteTarget. Badges ($defs/badge) exist only on icon_grid items. Props whose keys the plan only describes (activity_entry, notice_bar display, popup close button) stay open until the plan names them. popup may carry an optional Lottie animation {url, sha256} (image is then the static fallback) and an optional screen-reader name alt (04 §6.2, BR-TEXT-26). union_material carries channels [{platform, channel_id}] chosen from the channel whitelist (BR-TEXT-17 细则); the platforms list of the 03 §6.1 example is derived from channels and not accepted here. At most one popup per page; section ids unique per page (checked by the contracts-ts unit test and on save, not expressible here). Fixtures: contracts/fixtures/home-golden/*.json (invalid/ holds counter-examples).
title: Page

items.$comment: A delivered home page: a section of a registered type ($defs/home_registered_section, the same definition admission_home uses) is checked strictly by $defs/section; any other type is an unknown card, only its envelope is checked and the client skips it silently (03 §6.2). Saving such a section is refused by admission_home.

min_app_version.$comment: Per platform, "not lower than". A platform whose key is missing or null does not get the section (编排者默认 R4); a section without min_app_version is not filtered.

condition.$comment: Audience (03 §6.1). A missing key or a missing condition means any.

route_target.description:
In-app jump target {route, params} (contracts/routes.json; TECH-04). route stays a string on
purpose: a server may return a route newer than an installed client, which then opens the
upgrade page (03 §4.4), so the HTTP contract cannot pin the route list. The client checks
route and params against its own routes table (bridge RouteTarget) before opening; the
server only stores targets checked against routes.json when they are saved.

notice_item.description:
One notice-bar entry, shared by the static (home schema) and api (GET /v1/articles notice
category) sources; closing and content-version rules only in BR-TEXT-13 细则「首页公告条的
关闭与内容版本」 (04 §6.2).

not.description: A notice that cannot be closed must have end_at (BR-TEXT-13 细则「生效区间」).

item_id.description: For api entries the notice article id.

static_item.$comment: One entry of a static data source; keys other than action, image, start_at and end_at are left to each card until the plan names them. No badge: badges exist only on icon_grid items (BR-TEXT-29).

data_source_static_notice.$comment: notice_bar static: the entries are props.items (04 §6.2), the data source carries only kind.

tags.$comment: Console side only (CT-07f, D10-1986 / D10-1758 / D10-1761; 规划/04 §3.2): the home read delivers only the pool items whose tags share at least one value with these (exact equality after the server's normalization: NFKC, trimmed, inner whitespace one space); absent filters nothing (the read also treats [] so). Each tag has a character other than whitespace and no control character. The feed's fall-back pool (feed.fallback_pool_id) is never filtered. The page delivered to the apps and H5 never carries this field. Saving (adminCreatePageConfigVersion, D10-1777) applies the same normalization as pool items' tags (NFKC, trimmed, inner whitespace one space, blanks dropped) and keeps one of each duplicate in first-seen order, so the saved version holds the normalized list; a list that normalizes to an empty array (sent empty or all blanks) is refused with 20001 on this data source's tags, because dropping every item would silently turn the source from 'only the items with these tags' into 'no filter'.

data_source_union_material.$comment: Channels come from the server-side whitelist (specs/material-channels.yaml, BR-TEXT-17 细则); the client never sends a channel parameter (03 §6.3).

data_source_api.$comment: notice_bar only: the one source is the notice CMS (GET /v1/articles, notice category); no endpoint path is accepted (03 §6.3).

instant.$comment: A moment in ISO 8601 with the +08:00 offset (BR-TEXT-11), as written by the console; Z or another offset is refused.

core_route.$comment: Core entries no operation slot may show (BR-TEXT-28 不可配清单): orders (OrderList, OrderDetail, FindOrder), wallet and earnings (Wallet, Earnings, Ledger), withdrawal and its steps (Withdraw, WithdrawRecords, PayoutAccount, RealName, Reverify), the fixed 推广与邀请 group (ShareHub, InviteShare; Earnings above), settings (Settings), privacy and authorization (PrivacyCenter, DeleteAccount, DataCopy, AuthManage) and agreements (Agreement, LaborAgreement), whatever their params (empty params included). The server checks the same list again when saving.

in_app_target.description: Jump target allowed on the operation slots of me and search (BR-TEXT-30): a RouteTarget whose route is not ExternalPage and not a core entry (BR-TEXT-28); WebPage only with an https url (the server also checks the host against bridge_origins). The server checks route and params against contracts/routes.json (registered, entry includes in_app) when saving; an invalid target is 20001 with data.fields pointing at the jump field.

badge.$comment: Badge of an icon_grid item (BR-TEXT-29 徽标): kind none, dot (red dot) or text; text only with kind text, 1–2 characters counted as Unicode code points (the server also runs the BR-TEXT-13 banned-word check). expire_at is optional: from that moment the client hides the badge and keeps the item. Number badges come only from business data and cannot be configured.

icon_asset.$comment: A delivered icon picture with its digest, bound in one object (BR-TEXT-30 图标; same as the platform icons of BR-TEXT-24 and the popup lottie of BR-TEXT-26): url is the https address of the picture under the OSS media domain, its file named by the content digest (<sha256>.png or .svg, design/icons/README.md grid/), sha256 the lowercase hex SHA-256 of that file, which the client checks after download; the server checks on save that the file name equals sha256. The client shows only url, never another picture field.

icon_grid_item.$comment: One icon_grid entry of home (金刚区, 03 §6.3; 01 F-HOME-10). The shape the existing home drafts and the client vectors use is kept (CT-07a; specs/client/home-sdui-vectors.json goldenPages.icon_grid): keys other than those below stay open, the picture is image or icon, and icon may be a plain picture address as before or an {url, sha256} object. The digest binding of BR-TEXT-30 applies to me only ($defs/me_item, admission_me). badge is $defs/badge, the only badge shape of BR-TEXT-29 (none / dot / text up to 2 characters, optional expiry), on home as on me; badges exist only on icon_grid items.

section.$comment: Envelope checked for every type; registered types add their props and data_source below. min_app_version, props, data_source, condition, start_at and end_at are optional (missing = not filtered / everyone / not limited) and never null. An item's range must lie within its section's range and start_at must be before end_at (checked on save, 20001; not expressible here).

ad_label.$comment: Banner only: the promotion label, the SDUI field of the same name (BR-TEXT-17).

section_icon_grid.$comment: Icon grid (03 §6.3): home 金刚区 and me more_services. props are final: columns 4 or 5, rows 1–4 (the client pages further items). Items are icon_grid_item (badges only here). static.

section_product_scroll.$comment: Horizontal product strip (03 §6.3): title and the 「更多」 button target more_action (a RouteTarget; the key of the first client version, specs/client/home-sdui-vectors.json goldenPages.product_scroll). On home props stay open as before (CT-07a; the client drops a more_action it cannot route, 03 §4.4) and more_action may be any RouteTarget like home's static items; on search props are closed to title and more_action, and more_action is an in-app target (admission_search, BR-TEXT-30, D10-2401 ④). product_pool / union_material.

section_activity_entry.$comment: Activity entry (03 §6.3): 1–3 images, layout; key names not given by the plan yet, props stay open. static.

section_notice_bar.$comment: Notice bar (03 §6.3): scrolling / static display (key name not given by the plan yet, props stay open). static: data_source {kind: static} and props.items is a NoticeItem array (04 §6.2); api: data_source {kind: api} (the notice CMS) and props carry no items.

section_feed_infinite.$comment: Infinite material feed (03 §6.3): union_material only; the plan names no props.

section_popup.$comment: Popup (03 §6.1, §6.3; 04 §6.2 首页弹窗卡 popup; BR-TEXT-26; D10-109): at most one per page; image, daily times, time window (start, end), close button (key name not given by the plan yet, so props stay open). image is the popup picture, or the static fallback picture when lottie is set (lottie requires image). lottie {url, sha256} is optional: url is the https address of the Lottie JSON under the OSS media domain (file named by its content digest), sha256 the lowercase hex SHA-256 of that file, which the native client checks after download; both keys required, no other key. alt is the optional screen-reader name (1-40 characters); without it the client reads the default name 「首页弹窗」. lottie and alt are new optional keys, so the card version stays the same. static, items carry the action.

slot_me_more_services.$comment: The one section of me (BR-TEXT-28 准入表 me row): icon_grid with id more_services, static only, 4 columns (03 §10.2 EntryGrid), 1–12 items counted over the whole items array whatever their targets (D10-2401 ②). Each item has a name (title), an icon {url, sha256} and an in-app target, no plain image field.

me_item.$comment: One entry of me more_services (BR-TEXT-28 / 30): name 1–6 characters, icon {url, sha256} (the picture shown and its digest bound in one object, no other picture field), an in-app target, an optional badge and range. Closed.

slot_search_top.$comment: The one section of search (BR-TEXT-28 准入表 search row): the result-page top slot, id search_top, either a banner or a product_scroll on a product pool; which of the two is used and whether optional props are filled does not change the limit of one (D10-2401 ①). Every jump target in it (banner items, the product_scroll 「更多」 button more_action) is an in-app target; product_scroll props are closed.

home_registered_section.$comment: The registered section types of home (03 §6.3, CT-07a): exactly the types $defs/section checks strictly by type (its allOf branches). Shared by the delivered page (root, page_key home: these are strict, anything else is an unknown card the client skips) and admission_home (only these are saved). Batch 2 types (float_button, splash) and custom types are not in this list.

admission_home.$comment: Admission of home (BR-TEXT-28 准入表 home row), the check of the server's save / publish and of the console form: every section must be of a registered home type ($defs/home_registered_section, the same list the delivered page checks strictly) and pass $defs/section; popup at most one. Unregistered types, including the batch 2 types float_button and splash, are refused here (20001). The delivered page (root) still tolerates an unknown card and the client skips it (03 §6.2); that tolerance is for pages of newer servers, not something the console can save.

admission_me.$comment: Admission of me (BR-TEXT-28 准入表 me row): at most one section, the icon_grid more_services; an empty page is the fall-back to the client's built-in grid.

admission_search.$comment: Admission of search (BR-TEXT-28 准入表 search row): at most one section, the top slot search_top (banner or product_scroll on a product pool).
